mechanism: Use one locked direct-address frame and let a solo speaker's posture carry the arc: relaxed baseline, visible attention shift, forward engagement, compact gesture proof, then an earned release that returns the body toward the original depth. The reusable structure depends on posture, eye line and breath-sized pauses, not on source dialogue meaning.

invariants.rule: Keep one locked seated-eye-level direct-address frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: Coverage changes hide whether the performance arc works.

invariants.rule: Move from reclined to upright in one continuous visible shift.
invariants.ablation_failure: Starting upright removes the primary contrast.

invariants.rule: Use no more than one dominant gesture at the forward peak.
Insert a readable still pause after the peak.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate release makes the peak feel accidental.

invariants.rule: Return body depth toward the opening while changing expression.
invariants.ablation_failure: An unchanged final face makes the arc feel circular rather than resolved.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source green couch and living room
source exact gestures and laugh timing
